title: Cmd-W on the focused right pane, a line typed INSIDE the close warning's daemon read (held by debug.close.hold), then the read answers: the whole line runs in the left pane (8 tries)
why: STATUS 1333/1353: journey r3-after-switch round s3 (cmux19, build a0f707a2) pressed Cmd-W in the right pane and typed at once; the left shell ran 'cho ...'. A person's Cmd-W on a live terminal waits for the daemon's read (TabCloseGuard) and the closing terminal keeps the keyboard meanwhile, so the first key went into it.
source: P0 close-then-type (cmux-ad, 2026-10-31): a key typed after a close goes to the pane that has the focus after the close, never dropped

try 1: click into the right pane
try 1: hold the close warning's daemon read (debug.close.hold, DEBUG builds)
try 1: Cmd-W closes the focused right pane
try 1: a line typed at once after Cmd-W
try 1: release the read (its reply's 'resumed' must be 1: the line was typed inside it)
try 1: the whole line ran in the left pane (its first key too), the right pane is gone
